This easement is reserved upon and subject to the following terms and conditions: a Lessee shall not hereafter plant or construct, or cause or permit to be planted or constructed, or suffer to remain, upon the Premises any bush, shrub, tree, pole, fence, building, structure or other obstruction of any kind or nature whatsoever that extends, or that may at any time in the future extend, into the airspace above the Premises to an elevation exceeding that permitted by Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities. b. After Authority and/or its authorized agent has entered upon the Premises for such purposes, Authority and/or its authorized agent shall thereafter have the immediate and continuing right to enter upon the Premises and the continued, continual and continuing right to remove or mark and light any bush, shrub, tree, pole, fence, building, structure or obstruction of any kind or nature whatsoever extending up into the airspace above the Premises to an elevation exceeding that allowed by Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities; provided, however, that, before Authority and/or its authorized agents enter upon the Premises and remove or mark and light any such obstruction, Authority shall first give written notice of the existence of any such obstruction to Lessee, and Lessee shail have a period of thirty (30) days from and after such notice to remove any such obstruction, Lessee shall not have the option of marking and lighting any such obstruction. If Lessee shall fail to remove any such obstruction within such thirty (30) day period, then and in that event Authority and/or its authorized agents shall have the right to enter immediately upon the Premises without further notice and to remove therefrom any such obstruction as provided herein or at its sole option to mark and light any such obstruction, without any liability therefor. 4.1. Lessee acknowledges and agrees that the Premises are and shall be leased by Authority to Lessee in their present “AS IS, WHERE IS AND WITH ALL FAULTS” condition, and that Authority makes absolutely no representations or warranties whatsoever with respect to the Premises or the condition thereof. Lessee acknowledges that Authority has not investigated and does not warrant or represent to Lessee that the Premises are fit for the Permitted Use or for any other purpose or purposes whatsoever, and Lessee acknowledges that the Premises are to be leased to Lessee in their existing condition, ie, “AS IS, WHERE IS AND WITH ALL FAULTS”, on and as of the date hereof. Lessee agrees that Authority shall not be required to make any improvements, repairs or modifications whatsoever in or upon the Premises or any part thereof. Lessee’s execution of this Agreement constitutes a representation by Lessee to Authority that (i) Lessee has examined and inspected the Premises, (ii) Lessee has found the Premises to be satisfactory for Lessee’s intended use, and (iii) Lessee has accepted the Premises. 4.2 All Improvements shall be deemed to be considered an integral part of the Premises and title to such Improvements sball vest in Authority upon the expiration or earlier termination of the Term, free and clear of any liens or encumbrances whatsoever. -5-
ARTICLE V IMPROVEMENTS BY LESSEE 5.1 Lessee shall have the right to make such structural and nonstructural additions, alterations and changes to the Improvements as Lessee shall desire (the “Tenant Alterations”); provided, however, that (a) as to any Material Change (as defined herein), (i) Lessee shall submit plans and specifications for each such Material Change to Authority at least thirty (30) days in advance of the proposed construction date, which plans and specifications shall be subject to Authority’s reasonable approval that shall be given (or withheld) within thirty (30) days after Authority’s receipt of such plans and specifications, (ii) Lessee shall provide Authority with a detailed cost breakdown for the Tenant Alterations evidenced by such plans and specifications, and (iii) if Lessee has assigned or subleased its interest in this Agreement to another party (to the extent permitted by this Agreement), Lessee shall deliver to Authority unconditional payment and performance bonds for such work naming Authority and such assignee or sublessee of Lessee as dual obligees; (b) as to all Tenant Alterations (regardless of whether any such Tenant Alterations constitute a Material Change), (i) all construction shall be completed in a workmanlike manner and in material compliance with Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities, at Lessee’s sole expense, and (ii) such Tenant Alterations (whether structural or nonstructural) shall not reduce the fair market value of the Premises; and (c) Authority shall have the sole and absolute discretion to restrict or prohibit the construction of any Tenant Alterations within the area designated on Exhibit A-2 as the “Restricted Area”. In the event Authority disapproves any plans and specifications submitted by Lessee as described herein, Lessee may re-submit revised plans and specifications for review by Authority as provided in this Section
5.1. No material changes or alterations shall be made to plans and specifications approved by Authority without the prior written consent of Authority, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. One reproducible final copy of the plans for all completed Tenant Alterations shall be signed by Lessee and submitted to Authority within ninety (90) days following the completion thereof. The term “Material {00501171.7} -6- ARCHIVE.
Change” shall mean any proposed Tenant Alterations, the cost of which, individually or together with other Tenant Alterations to be completed concurrently therewith, exceeds Five Thousand and No/100 Dollars ($5,000). The term “Tenant Improvement Expenditures” shall mean the lesser of (A) Five Million and No/100 Dollars ($5,000,000) and (B) the actual amounts expended by Lessee with respect to Tenant Alterations that are permitted to be included within “Fenant Improvement Expenditures” as provided by Exhibit B-2 hereto and approved by Authority pursuant to this Section 5.1; provided, however, that the amount provided in the preceding clause (A) may be increased by an amount not to exceed One Million Six Hundred Thousand and No/100 Dollars ($1,600,000) to reflect actual costs incurred by Lessee for the replacement of roofs for the Improvements as approved by Authority pursuant to this Section 5.1. 5.2 All Tenant Alterations and equipment installed by Lessee or its agents or contractors shall conform to all Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities and shall be of high quality and shall be safe, fire resistant and attractive in appearance.
5.3. All Tenant Alterations shall be and remain the property of Lessee until the expiration or earlier termination of the Term, at which time all right, title and interest of Lessee in and to the Premises shall revert to Authority. Lessee may remove, prior to the expiration or earlier termination of the Term, any trade fixtures, signs and other personal property of Lessee not permanently affixed to the Premises that may be removed without damage to the Premises (the “Lessee’s Property”). Any portion of Lessee’s Property not removed prior to such expiration or earlier termination of the Term shall be deemed to be abandoned by Lessee and subject to the rights of Authority set forth in Section 12.5 hereof. any of the Premises and all that contractors and subcontractors have been paid all amounts due and owing to them with respect to such Tenant Alterations. Lessee shall not remove or demolish, in whole or in part, any material portion of the Improvements without the prior written consent of Authority, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. 5.6 Lessee agrees to conform with all of Authority’s signage standards and agrees not to display, install, inscribe, paint or affix any signs, advertisements or notices upon the Premises without the prior written consent of Authority, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. Upon the expiration or earlier termination of the Term, Lessee shall remove all signs, advertisements and notices installed by Lessee at the request of Authority and repair any damage to the Premises resulting from suck removal.
ARTICLE VI OPERATIONAL STANDARDS 6.1 Lessee agrees to operate upon and within the Premises in a safe and orderly manner. The management, maintenance and operation of the Premises shall at all times be under the supervision and direction of an active, qualified and competent manager of Lessee who shall at all times be subject to the direction and control of Lessee. The operations of Lessee, and those of its officers, agents, invitees, servants, employees, contractors, licensees and any other persons or entities which Lessee controls or has the right to control, shall be conducted in an orderly and proper manner so as not to annoy, disturb or offend others.
ARTICLE VIL MAINTENANCE During the Term, Lessee shall (i) maintain the Improvements in good order and repair, subject to normal wear and tear; (ii) not commit waste or impair the Premises; (iii) not abandon the Premises; (iv) keep Lessee’s Property in good working condition and replace such Lessee’s Property when necessary to keep such items in good working condition; (v) comply in all material respects with all Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities; (vi) provide prompt notification to {00501171.7} -§8- CHV
Authority of any material adverse change to the Premises, including, without limitation, any material change in the environmental condition of the Premises, and shall promptly undertake reasonable remediation and preventative actions in connection with any environmental condition originating within, upon or from the Premises; and (vii) return the Improvements at the expiration or earlier termination of the Term in as reasonably good condition as when received, subject to normal wear and tear. Authority has no responsibility to maintain or pay for any part of the repair, maintenance or replacement of the Premises. 7.2 In the event Lessee fails to comply with the requirements of this Article VII, Authority may, in addition, to other the other rights and remedies provided by this Agreement, take all actions necessary to effect compliance with this Article VI, and all funds expended by Authority for such purpose shall be repayable by Lessee as Rent within five (5) days after Authority provides written notice to Lessee of the amount of any such expenditures by Authority. Authority’s reasonable determination of the actions necessary to effect compliance with this Article VIT shall be final and conclusive. 7.3 Subject to Lessee’s reasonable security policies (which may, for example, require that Authority’s representative be accompanied by a representative of Lessee while present on the Premises), Authority shall have the right to enter the Premises during Lessee’s regular business hours to determine whether Lessee has complied with and is complying with the terms and conditions of this Agreement; provided, however, that Authority shall have the right to enter the Premises at any time in the event of an emergency without the necessity of complying with any security policies of Lessee. Lessee shall, in a timely manner, provide for the adequate sanitary handling and removal of all trash, garbage and other refuse caused as a result of Lessee’s operations. 7.5 Lessee shall have the right, but not the obligation, to provide security protection for the Premises as it may desire at its own cost. Such right, whether or not exercised by Lessee, shall not in any way be construed to limit or reduce the obligations of Lessee hereunder. Any security protection provided by Lessee shall be subject to the -9- ARCHIVE
authority granted to, and shall not hinder or interfere with the duties of, Authority’s Public Safety Department.
ARTICLE VIII COMPLIANCE 8.1 For purposes of this Agreement, “Applicable Laws” shall mean all present and future applicable laws, ordinances, orders, directives, rules, codes and regulations of federal, state and municipal authorities and agencies and their respective agencies, departments, authorities and commissions (individually, a “Governmental Authority” and collectively, the “Governmental Authorities”) and all present and future grant assurances provided by Authority to any Governmental Authority in connection with Authority’s ownership or operation of the Airport. For purposes of this Agreement, “Governmental Authorities” shall specifically include, without limitation, the United States Department of Transportation, the FAA and the Transportation Security Administration. Lessee, and its officers, agents, invitees, servants, employees, contractors, licensees and any other persons or entities that Lessee controls or has the right to control, shall comply with all Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities which may directly or indirectly affect the Airport, the Premises, Lessee or Lessee’s operations on or in connection with the Premises. If Authority incurs any fine or penalty due to Lessee’s violation of any such Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities, it is mutually agreed by Authority and Lessee that any such fine or penalty shall be directly passed on to Lessee by Authority. Lessee shall be solely responsible for the payment of any such fine and/or penalty. Lessee shall pay wages to persons employed in its operations at the Premises that are not less than the minimum wages required by Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities. 8.2 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Tennessee. Lessee and Authority acknowledge and agree that the exclusive venue for any actions to enforce or interpret this Agreement shall be the Chancery Court for Davidson County, Tennessee. {00501171.7) -10- ARCHIVE
8.3. Lessee hereby waives any claim against Authority, and its commissioners, consultants, agents, officers, directors and employees, for loss of anticipated profits caused by any suit or proceedings directly or indirectly attacking the validity of this Agreement or any part hereof, or by any judgment or award in any suit or proceeding declaring this Agreement to be null, void or voidable or delaying implementation of this Agreement or any part hereof. 8.4 shall not do anything by which the Premises, or any part thereof, shall be encumbered by a mortgage or deed of trust or by a mechanic’s, materialman’s or other lien for work or labor done, services performed, materials, appliances or power contributed, used or furnished in or to the Premises or in connection with any operations or any other activity of Lessee, and, if, whenever and as often as any lien may be filed against the Premises, or any part thereof, purporting to be for or on account of any labor done or materials or services furnished in connection with any work in or about the Premises by, for or under the authority of Lessee, or anyone claiming by, through or under Lessee, Lessee shall discharge the same of record within ten (10) days after service upon Lessee of notice of the filing thereof; provided, however, that Lessee shall have the right to remove the lien as an encumbrance upon the Premises by bonding the same in accordance with Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities and to contest any such lien; provided, further, that Lessee shall diligently prosecute any such contest, which must at all times effectively stay or prevent any official or judicial sale of the Premises under execution or otherwise, and, if unsuccessful, Lessee shall immediately satisfy any final judgment against Lessee enforcing such lien or, if successful, Lessee shall immediately obtain record satisfaction or release thereof.
ARTICLE IX ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLEASING 9.1 Lessee shall not assign this Agreement or allow the same to be assigned by operation of law or otherwise, or sublet the Premises or any part thereof, without the prior written consent of Authority, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, provided, however, that (i) Lessee acknowledges that certain provisions of this {00501171.7} -l1- ARCHIVE
Agreement are subject to or dictated by Lessee’s status as a governmental entity and (ii) in connection with any proposed assignment of this Agreement or sublease of the Premises or any portion thereof to a person or entity that does not possess the same legal rights and standing as Lessee, Authority shall have the right to impose such conditions upon its consent to such assignment or sublease as it shall determine in its sole discretion. 9.2 In the event Authority consents to any assignment or subletting on the part of Lessee under this Agreement, Lessee shall be and remain responsible for any and all payments due Authority hereunder and for the performance of any and all of Lessee’s obligations hereunder.
ARTICLE X INSURANCE 10.1 Lessee is a metropolitan form of government under the Tennessee Governmental Tort Liability Act, T.C.A. §§ 29-20-101, ez seg., and, as such, the general liability limits of Lessee are defined by law. Notwithstanding the governmental status of Lessee and the provisions of such Tennessee Governmental Tort Liability Act, Lessee, at its expense, shall maintain, throughout the Term of this Lease, commercial general liability insurance covering the Premises at least as broad as the most commonly available ISQ Commercial General Liability form (occurrence basis) insuring Authority, and its officers, employees and commissioners, against liabilities, damages, claims, costs, charges and expenses, including attorneys’ fees and costs of defense, incurred by Authority, or its officers, employees or commissioners, that result or arise from bodily injury, personal injury or property damage on or relating to the Premises, with a limit of not less than One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) per occurrence (the “Lessee’s Policy”). Lessee’s Policy shall (i) name Authority and its officers, employees and commissioners as the named insureds thereunder, (ii) contain no special limitations on the scope of the protection afforded to the named insureds, and (iii) contain no deductible or self- insurance retention. {00501171.7} -12- ARCHIVE

Such coverage amount may be increased (but not decreased) no more frequently than annually at the request of Authority to reflect the increased insurable value of the Improvements. If any of the Improvements shall be damaged by a fire or other casualty (a “Casualty”), Lessee shall, within thirty (30) days after such Casualty, commence restoration and repair of the Premises to substantially the same condition as preceded such Casualty. Rent shall not abate during the period of such restoration and repair. Lessee’s restoration and repair of the Premises must be commenced within thirty (30) days after such Casualty or, if the Premises are not restored and repaired as permitted below, payment of all insurance proceeds relating to the Premises, together with the amount of any deductible or self- insurance retention under the insurance policies providing such insurance proceeds, must be made by Lessee to Authority within ten (10) days after Lessee’s receipt of such insurance proceeds, In the event of a Casualty, Lessee shall be responsible for any deficiency between (i) the cost of restoring and repairing the Improvements (to substantially the same condition as preceded such Casualty) and restoring, repairing and replacing Lessee’s Property and (ii) the amount of the insurance proceeds paid with respect thereto. If the Improvements are damaged or destroyed by a Casualty and the Premises are thereby rendered untenantable or unsuitable because either (A) restoration and repair of the Premises are not economically practicable, in the reasonable judgment of Lessee and Authority, as a result of the cost of compliance with then Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities relating to the restoration and repair of the Premises, or (B) such restoration and repair would be undertaken during the last twelve (12) months of the Term, Lessee shall have the right, exercisable by written notice to Authority given within thirty (30) days after the date of such Casualty, to terminate this Agreement effective upon the date of such Casualty. shall pay to Authority the amount of any deductible or self-insurance retention under the insurance policies providing such insurance proceeds. Unless this Agreement is terminated as set forth above, Lessee, in addition to Lessee’s restoration and repair of the Premises, shall restore, repair and replace any of Lessee’s Property damaged or destroyed as a result of a Casualty so that Lessee can resume substantially the same business operations at the Premises as preceded such Casualty. To the extent Lessee is permitted to do so by Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities, Lessee shall maintain such other insurance on or in connection with the Premises as reasonably required from time to time by Authority that is then commonly obtained by property owners (or tenants) in connection with properties similar to and in the same area as the Premises. 10.4 All insurance companies providing the insurance coverages required under this Article X shall be selected by Lessee, shall be rated A minus (A-) or better by Best’s Insurance Rating Service (or equivalent rating service if not available) and shall be licensed to write insurance policies in the State of Tennessee. 11.1. This Agreement shall be subject to termination by Lessee in the event Authority breaches any of the material terms, covenants or conditions of this Agreement to be kept, performed and observed by Authority and Authority fails to remedy such breach (subject to Authority’s right to litigate the issue, which litigation shall stay this time period) for a period of sixty (60) days after written notice to Authority from Lessee of the existence of such breach or, if more than sixty (60) days shall be required because of the nature of such breach, if Authority shall fail within such sixty (60) day period to commence and thereafter diligently proceed to cure such breach. 11.2 Lessee shall be eligible for an equitable abatement of Base Rent (but not any other Rent under the terms hereof) during the continuance of any of the following circumstances or conditions during the Term: a. Lessee has the right to terminate this Agreement pursuant to Section 11.1 hereof but has not elected to do so; provided, however, that Lessee’s right to the abatement of Base Rent under this Section 11.2.a. shall not arise until Lessee has the actual right to terminate this Agreement. While any litigation commenced to determine whether Authority has breached any of the material terms, covenants or conditions of this Agreement to be kept, performed and observed by Authority, as described in Section 11.1 hereof, is pending, Lessee may elect to pay Base Rent into the court having jurisdiction over such litigation or to Authority, but Lessee shall not be relieved from the obligation to pay the entire amount of Base Rent due hereunder unless and until Lessee has the right to terminate this Agreement pursuant to Section 111 hereof; b. The issuance by any court of competent jurisdiction of any injunction, which is not the direct or indirect result of any act or omission of Lessee or any of its officers, agents, invitees, servants, employces, contractors, licensees or any other person or entity that Lessee controls or has the right to control, -15- ACV
preventing or restraining the use of the Airport in such a manner as to substantially restrict Lessee’s use of the Premises for the Permitted Use; or The assumption by the United States Government, or any authorized agency thereof, of the operation, control or use of Airport and its facilities in such a manner as to substantially restrict Lessee’s use of the Premises for the Permitted Use. Such abatement of Base Rent shall cease at such time as the circumstance or condition that permitted such abatement is no longer in existence or effect. Notwithstanding the foregoing terms of this Section 11.2, nothing in this Section 11,2 shall affect, suspend or abate any other obligations of Lessee under this Agreement, including, without limitation, the obligation of Lessee to repair and maintain the Premises as set forth in this Agreement, to maintain the insurance coverages required under this Agreement and to pay for all utilities and other charges relating to the Premises for which Lessee is responsible under this Agreement.
ARTICLE XII DEFAULT BY LESSEE; REMEDIES OF AUTHORITY 12.1 For purposes of this Agreement, an “Event of Default” shall be defined to mean the occurrence of any of the following: a. If Lessee shall fail to pay any payment of Rent or any other payment required by this Agreement and such failure shall continue for a period of five (5) days after Lessee’s receipt of written notice thereof; or b. If Lessee shall violate or fail to perform any other term, condition, covenant or agreement to be performed or observed by Lessee under this Agreement, and such failure shall continue for a period of thirty (30) days after Lessee’s receipt of written notice thereof (except as otherwise set forth in Section hereof); provided, however, that, in the event such violation or failure to perform is incapable of being cured or remedied within such thirty (30) day period, such violation or failure to perform shall not constitute an Event of Default hereunder for so long as Lessee commences curative or remedial action with respect to such violation or failure to perform within such thirty (30) day -16-
period and diligently pursues such curative or remedial action until the violation or failure to perform is cured or remedied; or If a permanent receiver is appointed for Lessee’s property, including, without limitation, Lessee’s interest in the Premises, and such receiver is not removed within ninety (90) days; or if Lessee files a voluntary petition or initiates a voluntary proceeding under any bankruptcy or other debtor relief laws; or if Lessee voluntarily takes advantage of any debtor relief proceedings under any present or future laws by which the Rent or any part thereof is, or is proposed to be, reduced or payment thereof deferred; or an involuntary petition or proceeding is filed against Lessee under any bankruptcy or debtor relief law and such petition or proceeding is not dismissed within ninety (90) days from the date of filing; or Lessee makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors; or the Premises or Lessee’s effects or interest therein should be levied upon or attached under process against Lessee; or d. If Lessee shall default or fail to comply with the terms of any other agreement with Authority and such default or failure to comply shall continue beyond the period, if any, that such other agreement provides for Lessee to cure such default or failure to comply. 12.2 Upon the occurrence of an Event of Default, Authority shall have the right, at its sole option, to do one or more of the following: a. Terminate this Agreement, in which event Lessee shall immediately surrender the Premises to Authority, but if Lessee shall fail to do so, Authority may, without further notice and without prejudice to any other remedy Authority may have for possession or arrearages in Rent, enter upon the Premises and expel or remove Lessee and its effects. In the event of a re-letting of the Premises by Authority, Authority shall apply the rent therefrom first to the payment of Authority’s expenses, including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys’ fees incurred by reason of such Event of Default, and the expense of re-letting and then to the payment of Rent and all other sums due from Lessee hereunder, with Lessee remaining liable for any deficiency. Such deficiency shall be calculated and paid monthly. In any event and notwithstanding any -17- ARCHIVE
such termination of this Agreement, Lessee shall remain liable for and shall pay the Rent that would otherwise have become due hereunder during the Term in the absence of such termination; b. Without terminating this Agreement, re-enter the Premises by summary proceedings and dispossess Lessee. In the event of such re-entry, Authority may re-let the Premises to such tenant or tenants for such reasonable term or terms as Authority may elect, and in the event of a re-letting Authority shall apply the rent therefrom first to the payment of Authority’s expenses, including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys’ fees incurred by reason of such Event of Default, and the expense of re-letting and then to the payment of Rent and all other sums due from Lessee hereunder, with Lessee remaining liable for any deficiency as it comes due under the terms hercof. No such re- entry or taking possession of the Premises by Authority shall be construed as an election on its part to terminate this Agreement unless a written notice of such intention is given to Lessee or unless the termination thereof is decreed by a court of competent jurisdiction. Notwithstanding any such re-letting without termination, Authority may at any time thereafter elect to terminate this Agreement for such previous breach; Demand specific performance or a mandatory injunction to require Lessee to perform its obligations hereunder; d. Cure the Event of Default and demand Lessee’s immediate repayment of all amounts expended or advanced by Authority in connection therewith; or e Pursue any other legal or equitable remedies available to Authority. 12.3 No right, power or remedy conferred upon or reserved to Authority hereunder is intended to be exclusive of any other right, power or remedy, but each and every such right, power and remedy shall be cumulative and concurrent and shall be in addition to any other right, power or remedy given hereunder or now or hereafter existing at Jaw or in equity or by statute. 12.4 If any proceeding shall at any time be commenced for recovery of possession of the Premises as aforesaid and compromise or settlement shall be effected either before or after judgment by which Lessee shall be permitted to retain possession of the {00501171.7} -18- ARCHIVE.
Premises, then such proceeding shall not constitute a waiver of any condition or agreement contained herein or of any subsequent breach thereof. 12.5 If Authority shall terminate this Agreement or take possession of the Premises by reason of an Event of Default, Lessee and those holding under Lessee shall forthwith remove their personal property from the Premises. If Lessee or any such claimant shall fail to effect such removal prior to the termination of the Term, Authority may, at its option and without liability to Lessee or those claiming under Lessee, remove such goods and effects and may store the same for the account of Lessee or the owner thereof at any place selected by Authority. Lessee shall be responsible for all costs of removal and storage. 12.6 If Authority shall enter into and repossess the Premises as a result of the occurrence of an Event of Default, then and in that event Lessee hereby covenants and agrees that Lessee will not claim the right to redeem or re-enter the Premises to restore its operations hereunder. Lessee hereby waives the right to such redemption and re- entry under any present or future law and hereby further, for any party claiming through or under Lessee, expressly waives its right, if any, to make payment of any Rent unpaid by Lessee hereunder and to claim any subrogation to the rights of Lessee under this Agreement by reason of such payment.
12.7. Any amount paid or expense or liability incurred by Authority for the account of Lessee shall be deemed to be Rent hereunder.
ARTICLE XIII CONDEMNATION 13.1 In the event of a taking of all or any part of the Premises for any public or quasi- public use under any governmental law, ordinance, regulation or right of eminent domain or a sale to the condemning authority under threat of condemnation or by agreement between Authority and/or Lessee and those authorized to exercise such right under threat of condemnation (a “Taking”) that, by agreement of Authority and Lessee, renders the Premises useless or materially affects the purposes for which this Agreement has been executed, this Agreement shall terminate as of the date of such Taking and all of Lessee’s rights and interests in the Premises shall {00501171.7) -19-
cease to exist. Lessee shall be entitled to recover from the condemning authority only that portion of the Award (as defined herein) allocable to the Tenant Improvement Expenditures, if any, not previously reimbursed to Lessee by credits against the Base Rent; provided, however, that, in no event shall the portion of such Award paid to Lessee exceed the Tenant Improvement Expenditures, if any, not previously reimbursed to Lessee by credits against the Base Rent, regardless of any formula used to allocate any such Award. Lessee shall retain its right to payment from the condemning authority for relocation assistance in accordance with Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities. Authority shall be entitled to the remaining portion of such Award. For purposes of this Agreement, the term “Award” shall mean the net proceeds received from any Taking after deducting the expenses of any settlement. 13.2 In the event of a Taking that does not result in a termination of this Agreement pursuant to Section 13.1 hereof, Authority shal! make its Award available to Lessee in accordance with a reasonable customary draw process and Lessee shall, to the extent of such Award, promptly restore and repair the Premises to substantially the same condition as existed immediately prior to such Taking insofar as is reasonably possible. If the estimated cost of restoration and repair shall exceed the amount of Authority’s Award, Lessee shall deposit with Authority the amount of such excess. The Award and any excess shalt be held in trust by Authority and used, to the extent required, for the purpose of such restoration and repair. A just and proportionate part of the Base Rent payable hereunder shall be abated from the date of such Taking until ten (10) days after Lessee has restored and repaired the same and thereafter the Base Rent shall be reduced in proportion to the reduction in the then rental value of the Premises after the Taking as compared with the rental value prior to the Taking. Authority and Lessee shall make a good faith determination of the rental value of the Premises after any such Taking based upon ail relevant factors, including, without limitation, the economic impact of the Taking upon the business of Lessee conducted at the Premises. If the Award shall exceed the amount spent or to be spent promptly to effect such restoration and repair, such excess shall unconditionally belong to Authority and shall be paid to Authority. {00501171.7} -20-
ARTICLE XIV AIRPORT EXPANSION 14,1 Lessee hereby acknowledges that during the Term it may become necessary for Authority to terminate this Agreement as to some or all of the Premises for Airport modification and/or expansion in order to adequately provide airport facilities and air service. Authority shall have the right to terminate this Agreement at any time with respect to all or a portion of the Premises in the event the Board of Commissioners of Authority shall determine, by resolution adopted in an open meeting at which Lessee shall be afforded an opportunity to be heard, that the Premises, or such portion thereof, are necessary for Airport modification or expansion. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, in the event of any such termination by Authority, Authority shall pay Lessee an amount equal to the Tenant Improvement Expenditures, if any, not previously reimbursed to Lessee by credits against the Base Rent, that relate only to the portion of the Premises affected by such termination. In addition, Authority shall pay to Lessee any relocation assistance required to be paid pursuant to and as limited by 49 C.F.R. Part 24, as the same may be amended from time to time. Authority shall give Lessee eighteen (18) months notice to vacate the Premises in the event of such complete or partial termination of this Agreement, and Lessee hereby agrees to execute such documentation as may be deemed necessary by Authority to evidence the complete or partial termination of this Agreement. In the case of a partial termination of this Agreement, the Base Rent shall be adjusted as if the portion of the Premises as to which this Agreement has been terminated had been the subject of a Taking (as defined herein) in the manner described in Section 13,2 hereof. Lessee shall relinquish the affected portion of the Premises at the expiration of such eighteen (18) month period without Authority’s resorting to the process of law. A resolution duly enacted by the Board of Commissioners of Authority shall be conclusive evidence that the Premises or such portion thereof are needed for Airport modification or expansion. Lessee acknowledges that a partial termination of this Agreement pursuant to an expansion of Runway 2L of the Airport would require {00501171.7} -21- ARCHIVE
the removal of a portion of the Improvements. In the event of an expansion of Runway 2L of the Airport that requires the removal of a portion of the Authority (at no additional expense to Lessee) agrees to undertake or reimburse Lessee for building modifications to enclose, make whole and restore functionality to the remaining Improvements. The rights and powers of Authority under this Section 14,1 may be exercised on multiple occasions.
ARTICLE XV SECURITY Lessee agrees to observe all security requirements of Governmental Authorities as they exist from time to time, and to take such steps as may be necessary or directed by Authority to ensure that its officers, agents, invitees, servants, employees, contractors, licensees and any persons or entities that Lessee controls or has the right to control observe such requirements. 15.2 If Authority incurs any fine and/or penalty imposed by any Governmental Authority, or any expense in enforcing the Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities as a result of the acts or omissions of Lessee or any of its officers, agents, invitees, servants, employees, contractors, licensees or any other persons or entities that Lessee controls or has the right to control, Lessee agrees to pay and/or reimburse Authority for all such fines, penalties and expenses. Lessee further agrees to correct any security deficiency with respect to the Premises identified by Authority or any Governmental Authority. Authority reserves the right to take whatever action it deems necessary to correct any security deficiency with respect to the Premises identified by Authority or any Governmental Authority, and Lessee shall immediately reimburse Authority for the costs and expenses of such remedy on demand therefor from Authority.
ARTICLE XVI HOLDING OVER 16.1 Any holding over by Lessee after the expiration or earlier termination of this Agreement, without the prior written consent of Authority, shall not be deemed to {00501171.7} -22- ARCHIVE.
operate as an extension or renewal of the Term but shall only create a tenancy from month-to-month which may be terminated by Authority at any time; provided, however, that the monthly installment of Base Rent during such month-to-month tenancy shall equal 150% of the monthly installment of Base Rent for the last month of the Term.
ARTICLE XVII AMENDMENT 17.1 No amendment, modification or alteration of the terms of this Agreement shall be binding unless the same is in writing, dated subsequent to the date hereof and duly executed by the parties hereto.
ARTICLE XVIII RELATIONSHIP OF PARTIES 18.1 Nothing contained herein shall be deemed or construed by the parties hereto, or by any third party, as creating the relationship of principal and agent, partners, joint venturers or any other similar such relationship between the parties hereto, The parties hereto understand and agree that neither the method of computation of Rent, nor any other provision contained herein, nor any acts of the parties hereto, creates a relationship other than the relationship of landlord and tenant between them.
ARTICLE XIX APPROVALS BY AUTHORITY 19.1 Unless otherwise specified in this Agreement, whenever this Agreement calls for approval or consent of Authority, such approval or consent shall be evidenced by the written approval or consent of the President of Authority or his designee. Except as expressly provided in this Agreement, whenever any provision hereof requires the consent or approval of Authority, Authority shall have the absolute and unconditional right to withhold its consent or approval. Whenever this Agreement provides that the approval or consent of Authority shall not be unreasonably withheld, Authority shall not be deemed to withhold it approval or consent -23- ARCHIVE
unreasonably if Authority determines that it should withhold its approval or consent (i) to ensure or facilitate compliance by Authority and the Airport with Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities, (ii) to ensure and facilitate the safe and efficient operation of the Airport, or (iii) to protect the structural integrity of any facilities located at the Airport, including, without limitation, the Improvements (together with any previously completed Tenant Alterations). In addition, Authority shall not be deemed to unreasonably withhold its approval or consent if the approval or consent of another person, entity or Governmental Authority is required in order for Authority to provide Authority’s approval or consent, and the approval or consent of such other person, entity or Governmental Authority cannot be obtained on terms and conditions acceptable to Authority.
ARTICLE XX ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLIANCE 20.1 Lessee specifically agrees to comply with and obey all Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities relating to protection of the environment. Lessee shall not cause or permit any Hazardous Substance to be used, stored or generated on the Premises, except for Hazardous Substances of types and in quantities customarily used or found in Lessee’s business so long as any such Hazardous Substance is used, stored and/or generated in full compliance with Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities. Lessee shall not cause or permit the “release” (as defined in 42 U.S.C. § 9601(22)) of any Hazardous Substance in, on or under the Premises or into any ditch, conduit, stream, storm sewer or sanitary sewer connected thereto or located thereon. 20.2 Upon the termination of this Agreement or vacation of the Premises, Lessee shall, at Lessee’s sole expense and in compliance with all Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities, remove or permanently clean all Hazardous Substances that Lessee or any of Lessee’s officers, agents, invitees, servants, employees, contractors, licensees or any person or entity that Lessee controls or has the right to control, caused to be situated on, at, in or under the Premises. Lessee shall provide Authority with copies of all records related to any Hazardous Substance which are required to be -24- ARCHIVE
maintained by Lessee pursuant to Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities. Lessee shall, at Lessee’s sole expense, clean-up, remove and remediate any Hazardous Substance in, on or under the Premises in excess of allowable levels established by Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities; provided, however, that this obligation does not apply to a “release” (as defined in 42 U.S.C. § 9601(22)) of any Hazardous Substance that existed on the Premises prior to the date of this Agreement. 20.3 As used herein, the term “Hazardous Substance” means and includes any and all substances, chemicals, wastes, sewage or other materials which are now or hereafter regulated, controlled or prohibited by Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities requiring removal, warning or restriction on the use, generation, disposal or transportation thereof, including, without limitation, (a) any substance defined as a “hazardous substance”, “hazardous material”, “hazardous waste”, “toxic substance” or “air pollutant” in the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act of 1980, 42 U.S.C. §§ 9601, e¢ seq., the Hazardous Materials Transportation Act, 49 U.S.C. §§ 1801, et seq., the Resource Conservation and Recovery Act of 1976, 42 U.S.C. §§ 6901, ef seq., the Federal Water Pollution Control Act, 33 U.S.C. §§ 1251, et seg., or the Clean Air Act, 42 U.S.C. §§ 7401, ef seg., all as amended from time to time hereafter; (b) any hazardous substance, hazardous waste, toxic substance, toxic waste, hazardous material, waste, chemical or compound described in any other Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities now or at any time hereafter in effect regulating, relating to or imposing liability or standards of conduct concerning any hazardous, toxic or dangerous substance, chemical, material, compound or waste, including, without limitation, asbestos; flammable, explosive or radioactive materials; gasoline; oil; motor oil; waste oil; petroleum (including without limitation, crude oil or any fraction thereof); petroleum-based products; paints and solvents; lead; cyanide; DDT; printing inks; acids; pesticides; ammonium compounds; polychlorinated biphenyls; and other regulated chemical products; and (c) any other contaminant or pollutant that creates or threatens to create a substantial threat to human health or -25- VE
the environment and that is required to be removed, cleaned-up or remediated by Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities. 20.4 To the best of Authority’s current actual knowledge and belief as of the date of this Agreement, Authority is not aware of any disposal of any Hazardous Substance in or upon the Premises prior to the date hereof except as set forth in Exhibit C hereto.
ARTICLE XXI TAXES 21.1 Lessee is a governmental entity and is exempt from taxes. As such, Lessee shall not be responsible for any taxes that are imposed upon Authority with respect to the Premises. Furthermore, Authority understands that it cannot claim exemption from taxes by virtue of any exemption which is provided to Lessee. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Lessee shall be responsible for the payment of any tax, assessment or other governmental or similar charge relating to the Premises that may legally be assessed against Lessee and/or that Lessee may legally pay, and Lessee covenants to furnish to Authority, promptly upon request, proof of the payment of any such tax, assessment or other governmental or similar charge.
ARTICLE XXII GENERAL PROVISIONS 22.1 Each of Lessee and Authority agrees that it shall not permit or allow for the promotion, demotion, employment, dismissal or laying off of any individual due to race, creed, color, national origin, handicap, age or sex or in violation of Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities concerning the of individuals with disabilities. Each of Lessee and Authority represents and warrants that its policy is not to discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, color, national origin, handicap or disability in its hiring and employment practices or in admission to, access to or operation of its programs, services and activities. With regard to all aspects of this Agreement, each of Authority and Lessee represents and warrants to the other that it will comply with this policy. Lessee further represents and warrants that no person shail be excluded from participation in, denied the benefits of, discriminated against in the admission or access to, or discriminated against in treatment or {00501171.7} -26-
employment in Lessee’s operations or activities, on the grounds of disability, age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin or any other classification protected by Applicable Laws of Governmental Authorities, and no such person shall be excluded from participation in, denied the benefits of, or otherwise subjected to discrimination in the performance of contracts with Lessee or in the employment practices of Lessee’s contractors. Accordingly, Authority and Lessee, upon reasonable request by the other, shall show proof to the other of such nondiscrimination and post notices of nondiscrimination in conspicuous places that are available to all employees and applicants. 22.2 Nothing herein contained shall be deemed to grant Lessee any exclusive right or privilege within the meaning of Section 308 of the Federal Aviation Act of 1958, as amended (the “Federal Aviation Act”), or the conduct of any activity at the Airport, except that, subject to the terms and provisions hereof, Lessee shall have the right to possess the Premises under the provisions of this Agreement.
22.3. This Agreement is subject and subordinate to the provisions of any agreement heretofore or hereafter made between Authority and the federal government of the United States or any agency or department thereof relating to the operation or maintenance of the Airport, the execution of which has been required as a condition precedent to the transfer of federal rights or property to Authority for aviation purposes or to the expenditure of federal funds for the improvement or development of the Airport, including, without limitation, the expenditure of federal funds for the development of the Airport in accordance with provisions of the Federal Aviation Act. 22.4 No waiver of any default or breach by either party hereto of any of the terms, covenants and conditions hereof to be performed, kept and observed by the other party hereto shall be construed as, or shall operate as, a waiver of any subsequent default of any of the terms, covenants or conditions herein contained to be performed, kept and observed by such other party hereto. 22.5 Wherever in this Agreement it shall be required or permitted that notice or demand be given or served by one party to this Agreement to or on the other, such notices or demands shall be given or served in writing and personally delivered or sent by {00801171.7) -27- ACV
certified United States Mail, postage prepaid, or by recognized overnight delivery service Federal Express or United Parcel Service), with costs prepaid, to the addresses set forth below: To Authority: President The Metropolitan Nashville Airport Authority Nashville International Airport One Terminal Drive, Suite 501 Nashville, Tennessee 37214 With a copy to: Vice President of Legal Affairs and Government Relations The Metropolitan Nashville Airport Authority Nashville International Airport One Terminal Drive, Suite 501 Nashville, Tennessee 37214 To Lessee: The Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County Finance Department Real Estate Manager 222 3" Avenue North, Suite 701 Nashville, Tennessee 37201 The person and place to which notices are to be sent may be changed by a party hereto upon written notice to the other. A notice required or permitted hereunder shall be deemed received on the date that is three (3) calendar days after the date on which the notice is deposited in the United States Mail if sent by certified mail, or, if personally delivered, on the date such personal delivery is made. If notice is given by recognized overnight delivery service, the notice shall be deemed received on the next business day for the addressee following the date on which the notice is deposited with such recognized overnight delivery service. 22.6 The headings of the sections, subsections and paragraphs of this Agreement are inserted only as a matter of convenience and for reference and in no way define, limit or describe the scope or intent of any provisions of this Agreement and shall not be construed to affect in any manner the terms and provisions hereof or the interpretation or construction thereof. {00501171.7} -28- CHV
22.7 If one or more clauses, sections or provisions of this Agreement shall be held to be unlawful, invalid or unenforceable, the parties hereto agree that the material rights of either party hereto shall not be affected thereby except to the extent of such holding, and this Agreement shall be construed in all respects as if such invalid or unenforceable provision were omitted herefrom. 22.8 The parties hereto hereby designate the following as their agents for service of process and will waive any objection to service of process if served upon its agent as set forth below: For Lessee: Metropolitan Department of Law 204 Metropolitan Courthouse Nashville, Tennessee 37201 For Authority: President The Metropolitan Nashville Airport Authority Nashville International Airport One Terminal Drive, Suite 501 Nashville, Tennessee 37214 22.9 The parties hereto further covenant and agree that Authority reserves the right to further develop or improve the Airport and all landing areas and taxiways as it may see fit, regardless of the desires or views of Lessee and without interference or hindrance. 22.10 All exhibits referred to in this Agreement are intended to be and hereby are specifically made a part of this Agreement. 22.11 The parties hereto incorporate herein by reference all provisions lawfully required to be contained herein by any Governmental Authority. 22.12 No commissioner, member, officer, agent or employee of Authority or Lessee shall be charged personally or held contractually liable by or to the other party hereto under this Agreement or because of any breach or default hereunder.
22.13. This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the successors and permitted assigns of the parties hereto. {00S01171.7} -29- ARCHIVE
22.14 In the event that any Governmental Authority requires modifications or changes in this Agreement as a condition precedent to the granting of funds for the improvement of the Airport or otherwise, Lessee agrees to execute and deliver such amendments, modifications or supplements to this Agreement as may be so required by such Governmental Authority, and Authority shall be responsible for the cost and expense of preparing any such amendments, modifications or supplements. 22.15 Time is of the essence in the performance and/or satisfaction of the duties and/or conditions of this Agreement. 22.16 Words of any gender used in this Agreement shall be construed to include any other gender, and the singular and the plural forms of words each shall include the other unless the context otherwise requires. 22.17 Neither Authority nor Lessee shall be deemed in violation of this Agreement if it is prevented from performing any of its obligations hereunder (other than the payment of money) by reason of a strike, boycott, labor dispute, embargo, shortage of material, Act of God, act of the public enemy, act of superior governmental authority, weather condition, riot, rebellion, sabotage, terrorism or any other circumstances for which it is not responsible or which are not within its control. 22.18 Authority hereby represents and warrants that, as of the date of this Agreement and to the best of its knowledge, neither the Mayor of Lessee nor any member of the Metropolitan County Council, nor the director of any department of Lessee, nor any other official or employee of Lessee, has a direct or indirect personal monetary or financial interest in this Agreement. Lessee hereby represents and warrants that, as of the date of this Agreement and to the best of its knowledge, neither Authority nor any officer, employee or commissioner of Authority has given or donated, or promised to give or donate, either directly or indirectly, to any official or employee of Lessee or to anyone else for its benefit, any sum of money or other thing of value to aid or assist in obtaining this Agreement. Authority hereby represents and warrants that, to the best of its knowledge, neither Lessee nor any official or employee of Lessee has given any sum of money or other thing of value to any official or employee of Authority or to anyone else for its benefit for aid or assistance in obtaining this Agreement. Lessee acknowledges that the Mayor of {00501171.7} -30- ARCHIVE
Lessee is a member of the Board of Commissioners of Authority but acts in his rather than personal capacity in such position. 22.19 If, on account of a continued default or breach by either party hereto of its obligations under the terms of this Agreement, it shall be necessary for the other party hereto to employ an attorney to enforce or defend any of its rights or remedies hereunder, then in such event, any reasonable amounts incurred thereby as attorneys’ fees shall be paid by the defaulting party to the non-defaulting party. 22.20 The parties hereto understand and agree that this Agreement contains the entire agreement between the parties hereto with respect to the leasing of the Premises. Each party hereto further acknowledges and agrees that the other party hereto and its agents and representatives have made no representations or promises with respect to this Agreement other than as expressly set forth in this Agreement, and that each party hereto shall not assert any claim, liability or cause for termination against the other party hereto by reason of the making of any representations or promises not expressly stated in this Agreement.
22.21. The parties hereto acknowledge that they have thoroughly read this Agreement, including, without limitation, the exhibits and attachments hereto, and have sought and received competent advice and counsel which was necessary for them to form a full and complete understanding of all rights and obligations herein. 22.22 Authority acknowledges that this Agreement is not binding except and until all appropriate official signatures of Lessee have been fully obtained, this Agreement has been approved by the Metropolitan County Council and this Agreement has been filed with the Metropolitan Clerk. JHS Johnson Health and Safety, LLC October 22, 2004 Mr. Jim Hale Facilities Manager Genesco Inc. 1415 Murfreesboro Road, Suite 198 Nashville, TN 37217 SUBJECT: Asbestos Encapsulation Report Genesco Park Complex Excluding GPAB 1415 Murfreesboro Road Nashville, TN 37217 Dear Jim: Johnson Health and Safety, LLC (JHS) performed a Phase | Environmental Site Assessment (ESA) of the Genesco Park Complex located at 1415 Murfreesboro Road, Davidson County, Tennessee on March 7" and 8", 2004. The investigation revealed recognized environmental conditions that were being managed by Genesco maintenance personnel at the Complex. The primary recognized condition on the property was asbestos-containing materials (ACM), which was identified within each of the five buildings (Powerhouse, J&M Plant, Genstar, GPT and GPAB). Due to the age of the buildings, its appearance and known bulk laboratory analysis results, a significant amount of insulation around water and steam pipes and within mechanical rooms contained asbestos. JHS recommended that the aged or damaged insulating asbestos-containing materials (ACM) inside the Genesco Park Complex be properly encapsulated, where feasible, so that it can be safely managed in place or recommended that the damaged ACM be removed by a properly licensed asbestos abatement contractor. Since the ESA, the asbestos-containing materials (ACM) noted in the ESA report have been properly encapsulated and some minor amounts of ACM have been removed, with the exception of GPAB. The Genesco Park Administration Building (GPAB) was the only building at the Complex that was not included in the ACM encapsulation or removal project. It was recorded that only six (6) heavy- duty garbage bags full of ACM had to removed and properly disposed of for the project. In the Powerhouse Chilier Room and Powerhouse Boiler Room, there were multiple areas where pipe insulation containing asbestos was properly encapsulated.
